title: षडशीत्यधिकशततमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 186 · Markandeya sees the dissolution and the divine child

summary.en: Markandeya describes the cycle of the ages, the decline of Kali and the dissolution of the world in fire and flood. Wandering alone in the endless ocean, he saw a radiant child seated on a banyan branch, entered his body and beheld all the worlds within it, and came out again at the child's word.
summary.kn: ಮಾರ್ಕಂಡೇಯರು ಯುಗಚಕ್ರ, ಕಲಿಯ ಅವನತಿ, ಅಗ್ನಿ ಪ್ರವಾಹಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಲೋಕಪ್ರಳಯವನ್ನು ವರ್ಣಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಅನಂತ ಸಮುದ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂಟಿಯಾಗಿ ಅಲೆಯುವಾಗ ಆಲದ ಕೊಂಬೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕುಳಿತ ತೇಜಸ್ವಿ ಶಿಶುವನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಅವನ ದೇಹ ಪ್ರವೇಶಿಸಿ ಅದರೊಳಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲ ಲೋಕಗಳನ್ನೂ ಕಂಡು ಶಿಶುವಿನ ಮಾತಿನಿಂದ ಹೊರಬಂದೆ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ.
summary.hi: मार्कण्डेय युगचक्र, कलि के पतन और अग्नि तथा जल-प्रलय में संसार के विलय का वर्णन करते हैं। अनन्त सागर में अकेले भटकते हुए उन्होंने बरगद की शाखा पर बैठे एक दीप्त बालक को देखा, उसके शरीर में प्रवेश कर सब लोक उसके भीतर देखे, और बालक के कहने पर फिर बाहर आए।
summary.te: మార్కండేయుడు యుగచక్రాన్ని, కలి క్షీణతను, అగ్ని వరదలతో లోకప్రళయాన్ని వర్ణిస్తాడు. అనంత సముద్రంలో ఒంటరిగా తిరుగుతుండగా మర్రికొమ్మపై కూర్చున్న తేజస్వి శిశువును చూసి, అతని దేహంలో ప్రవేశించి అందులో సమస్త లోకాలను దర్శించి, శిశువు మాటతో బయటకు వచ్చానంటాడు.
summary.ta: மார்க்கண்டேயர் யுகச் சுழற்சியையும், கலியின் வீழ்ச்சியையும், தீயாலும் வெள்ளத்தாலும் உலகம் அழிவதையும் வர்ணிக்கிறார். முடிவற்ற கடலில் தனியே அலைந்தபோது ஆலங்கிளையில் அமர்ந்த ஒளிமிக்க குழந்தையைக் கண்டு, அதன் உடலுள் புகுந்து அனைத்து உலகங்களையும் அதனுள் கண்டு, குழந்தையின் சொல்லால் மீண்டும் வெளிவந்ததாகச் சொல்கிறார்.
summary.ml: യുഗചക്രം, കലിയുടെ ക്ഷയം, അഗ്നിയിലും പ്രളയത്തിലും ലോകം ലയിക്കുന്നത് മാർക്കണ്ഡേയൻ വിവരിക്കുന്നു. അനന്തമായ സമുദ്രത്തിൽ ഒറ്റയ്ക്ക് അലയുമ്പോൾ, ഒരു ആലിലയിൽ ഇരിക്കുന്ന തേജസ്സുള്ള ഒരു ശിശുവിനെ അദ്ദേഹം കാണുന്നു; ആ ശിശുവിന്റെ ശരീരത്തിൽ കടന്ന് അതിനുള്ളിലെ സകല ലോകങ്ങളും കണ്ട്, ശിശുവിന്റെ വാക്കിനാൽ പുറത്തുവരുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 3.186; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Apr 11 2022

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
ततः स पुनरेवाथ मार्कण्डेयं यशस्विनम् ।
पप्रच्छ विनयोपेतो धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: Then Yudhishthira, king of dharma, full of humility, again questioned the renowned Markandeya.

verses.text:
नैके युगसहस्रान्तास्त्वया दृष्टा महामुने ।
न चापीह समः कश्चिदायुषा तव विद्यते ।
वर्जयित्वा महात्मानं ब्राह्मणं परमेष्ठिनम् ॥

meaning.en: "Great sage, you have seen not one but many ends of thousands of yugas, and no one here equals you in lifespan, except the great-souled brahmin, Parameshthin.

verses.text:
अनन्तरिक्षे लोकेऽस्मिन्देवदानववर्जिते ।
त्वमेव प्रलये विप्र ब्रह्माणमुपतिष्ठसि ॥

meaning.en: In this world, when it has no sky and is empty of gods and danavas, you alone, brahmin, wait upon Brahma at the dissolution.

verses.text:
प्रलये चापि निर्वृत्ते प्रबुद्धे च पितामहे ।
त्वमेव सृज्यमानानि भूतानीह प्रपश्यसि ॥

meaning.en: And when the dissolution is over and the Grandsire has awakened, you alone watch the beings being created here,

verses.text:
चतुर्विधानि विप्रर्षे यथावत्परमेष्ठिना ।
वायुभूता दिशः कृत्वा विक्षिप्यापस्ततस्ततः ॥

meaning.en: in their four kinds, brahmin sage, as the Supreme Lord does it, after making the directions wind and scattering the waters here and there.

verses.text:
त्वया लोकगुरुः साक्षात्सर्वलोकपितामहः ।
आराधितो द्विजश्रेष्ठ तत्परेण समाधिना ॥

meaning.en: You have worshiped the world's teacher, the Grandsire of all worlds in person, best of brahmins, with devoted concentration.

verses.text:
तस्मात्सर्वान्तको मृत्युर्जरा वा देहनाशिनी ।
न त्वा विशति विप्रर्षे प्रसादात्परमेष्ठिनः ॥

meaning.en: For that reason death, the ender of all, and old age, the destroyer of bodies, do not enter you, brahmin sage, by the grace of the Supreme Lord.

verses.text:
यदा नैव रविर्नाग्निर्न वायुर्न च चन्द्रमाः ।
नैवान्तरिक्षं नैवोर्वी शेषं भवति किंचन ॥

meaning.en: When there is no sun, no fire, no wind, no moon, no sky and no earth, and nothing at all remains,

verses.text:
तस्मिन्नेकार्णवे लोके नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे ।
नष्टे देवासुरगणे समुत्सन्नमहोरगे ॥

meaning.en: in that world of one ocean, with moving and unmoving things destroyed, with hosts of gods and asuras gone and the great serpents extinct,

verses.text:
शयानममितात्मानं पद्मे पद्मनिकेतनम् ।
त्वमेकः सर्वभूतेशं ब्रह्माणमुपतिष्ठसि ॥

meaning.en: you alone wait upon Brahma, lord of all beings, who lies on a lotus, of immeasurable self, whose house is the lotus.

verses.text:
एतत्प्रत्यक्षतः सर्वं पूर्ववृत्तं द्विजोत्तम ।
तस्मादिच्छामहे श्रोतुं सर्वहेत्वात्मिकां कथाम् ॥

meaning.en: All this past you have seen with your own eyes, best of brahmins, so we wish to hear the tale that comprises the causes of everything.

verses.text:
अनुभूतं हि बहुशस्त्वयैकेन द्विजोत्तम ।
न तेऽस्त्यविदितं किंचित्सर्वलोकेषु नित्यदा ॥

meaning.en: You alone, best of the twice-born, have experienced it many times; nothing in all the worlds is ever unknown to you."

verses.text: मार्कण्डेय उवाच

meaning.en: Markandeya said:

verses.text:
हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि नमस्कृत्वा स्वयम्भुवे ।
पुरुषाय पुराणाय शाश्वतायाव्ययाय च ॥

meaning.en: "Very well, I will tell you, after bowing to the Self-existent One, the ancient, eternal and imperishable Person.

verses.text:
य एष पृथुदीर्घाक्षः पीतवासा जनार्दनः ।
एष कर्ता विकर्ता च सर्वभावनभूतकृत् ॥

meaning.en: This Janardana, with broad long eyes and yellow garments, is the maker and unmaker, the one who brings about all things and beings.

verses.text:
अचिन्त्यं महदाश्चर्यं पवित्रमपि चोत्तमम् ।
अनादिनिधनं भूतं विश्वमक्षयमव्ययम् ॥

meaning.en: He is inconceivable, a great wonder, pure and supreme, without beginning or end, the very being of the universe, undying and unchanging.

verses.text:
एष कर्ता न क्रियते कारणं चापि पौरुषे ।
यो ह्येनं पुरुषं वेत्ति देवा अपि न तं विदुः ॥

meaning.en: He is the doer and is not made; he is the cause too in a man's effort. Even the gods do not know the one who knows this Person.

verses.text:
सर्वमाश्चर्यमेवैतन्निर्वृत्तं राजसत्तम ।
आदितो मनुजव्याघ्र कृत्स्नस्य जगतः क्षये ॥

meaning.en: All this came to pass as a wonder, best of kings, from the beginning, tiger among men, at the destruction of the entire world.

verses.text:
चत्वार्याहुः सहस्राणि वर्षाणां तत्कृतं युगम् ।
तस्य तावच्छती संध्या संध्यांशश्च ततः परम् ॥

meaning.en: They say the Krita Yuga is four thousand years; its dawn is four hundred years, and its twilight four hundred after it.

verses.text:
त्रीणि वर्षसहस्राणि त्रेतायुगमिहोच्यते ।
तस्य तावच्छती संध्या संध्यांशश्च ततः परम् ॥

meaning.en: The Treta Yuga is said to be three thousand years; its dawn is three hundred years, and its twilight three hundred after it.

verses.text:
तथा वर्षसहस्रे द्वे द्वापरं परिमाणतः ।
तस्यापि द्विशती संध्या संध्यांशश्च ततः परम् ॥

meaning.en: Likewise the Dvapara is measured at two thousand years; its dawn is two hundred and its twilight two hundred after it.

verses.text:
सहस्रमेकं वर्षाणां ततः कलियुगं स्मृतम् ।
तस्य वर्षशतं संध्या संध्यांशश्च ततः परम् ।
संध्यासंध्यांशयोस्तुल्यं प्रमाणमुपधारय ॥

meaning.en: Then the Kali Yuga is held to be one thousand years; its dawn is a hundred years, and its twilight a hundred after it. Understand that dawn and twilight are of equal measure.

verses.text:
क्षीणे कलियुगे चैव प्रवर्तति कृतं युगम् ।
एषा द्वादशसाहस्री युगाख्या परिकीर्तिता ॥

meaning.en: When the Kali Yuga has ended, the Krita Yuga begins again. This is the cycle of yugas, called twelve thousand.

verses.text:
एतत्सहस्रपर्यन्तमहो ब्राह्ममुदाहृतम् ।
विश्वं हि ब्रह्मभवने सर्वशः परिवर्तते ।
लोकानां मनुजव्याघ्र प्रलयं तं विदुर्बुधाः ॥

meaning.en: A thousand of these is declared a day of Brahma. The whole universe turns about in Brahma's house; the wise know that as the dissolution of the worlds, tiger among men.

verses.text:
अल्पावशिष्टे तु तदा युगान्ते भरतर्षभ ।
सहस्रान्ते नराः सर्वे प्रायशोऽनृतवादिनः ॥

meaning.en: When the end of the yuga is near, with little left, best of the Bharatas, at the thousand's end almost all men speak falsehood.

verses.text:
यज्ञप्रतिनिधिः पार्थ दानप्रतिनिधिस्तथा ।
व्रतप्रतिनिधिश्चैव तस्मिन्काले प्रवर्तते ॥

meaning.en: In that time, Partha, substitutes come into use for sacrifice, for charity and for vows.

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणाः शूद्रकर्माणस्तथा शूद्रा धनार्जकाः ।
क्षत्रधर्मेण वाप्यत्र वर्तयन्ति गते युगे ॥

meaning.en: Brahmins do the work of shudras, and shudras earn wealth or live by the kshatriya's dharma, as the age goes by.

verses.text:
निवृत्तयज्ञस्वाध्यायाः पिण्डोदकविवर्जिताः ।
ब्राह्मणाः सर्वभक्षाश्च भविष्यन्ति कलौ युगे ॥

meaning.en: In the Kali age brahmins will abandon sacrifice and study, will lack offerings of rice-balls and water, and will eat anything.

verses.text:
अजपा ब्राह्मणास्तात शूद्रा जपपरायणाः ।
विपरीते तदा लोके पूर्वरूपं क्षयस्य तत् ॥

meaning.en: Brahmins will not mutter prayers, dear one, while shudras are devoted to prayer. When the world is reversed like this, that is the foretoken of its end.

verses.text:
बहवो म्लेच्छराजानः पृथिव्यां मनुजाधिप ।
मिथ्यानुशासिनः पापा मृषावादपरायणाः ॥

meaning.en: There will be many foreign kings on earth, lord of men, sinful, ruling falsely and given to lies.

verses.text:
आन्ध्राः शकाः पुलिन्दाश्च यवनाश्च नराधिपाः ।
काम्बोजा और्णिकाः शूद्रास्तथाभीरा नरोत्तम ॥

meaning.en: Andhras, Shakas, Pulindas and Yavanas will be kings, lord of men, and Kambojas, Aurnikas, shudras and Abhiras, best of men.

verses.text:
न तदा ब्राह्मणः कश्चित्स्वधर्ममुपजीवति ।
क्षत्रिया अपि वैश्याश्च विकर्मस्था नराधिप ॥

meaning.en: Then no brahmin will live by his own dharma; kshatriyas and vaishyas too will be engaged in wrong occupations, lord of men.

verses.text:
अल्पायुषः स्वल्पबला अल्पतेजःपराक्रमाः ।
अल्पदेहाल्पसाराश्च तथा सत्याल्पभाषिणः ॥

meaning.en: People will be short-lived, of little strength, little energy and prowess, small-bodied and of little substance, and will speak little truth.

verses.text:
बहुशून्या जनपदा मृगव्यालावृता दिशः ।
युगान्ते समनुप्राप्ते वृथा च ब्रह्मचारिणः ।
भोवादिनस्तथा शूद्रा ब्राह्मणाश्चार्यवादिनः ॥

meaning.en: Many regions will be empty, the quarters filled with beasts and snakes. When the end of the yuga arrives, students of Brahman will be futile, and shudras will address others as 'sir' while brahmins will say 'you'.

verses.text:
युगान्ते मनुजव्याघ्र भवन्ति बहुजन्तवः ।
न तथा घ्राणयुक्ताश्च सर्वगन्धा विशां पते ।
रसाश्च मनुजव्याघ्र न तथा स्वादुयोगिनः ॥

meaning.en: At the end of the yuga, tiger among men, there will be many creatures, but not endowed with such sense of smell for all scents, lord of men, and flavors will not be so pleasing, tiger among men.

verses.text:
बहुप्रजा ह्रस्वदेहाः शीलाचारविवर्जिताः ।
मुखेभगाः स्त्रियो राजन्भविष्यन्ति युगक्षये ॥

meaning.en: Women will have many children, small bodies, and no good character or conduct, and, O king, they will use their mouths as organs of lust at the end of the yuga.

verses.text:
अट्टशूला जनपदाः शिवशूलाश्चतुष्पथाः ।
केशशूलाः स्त्रियो राजन्भविष्यन्ति युगक्षये ॥

meaning.en: Regions will be full of watchtowers' spikes, crossroads will be full of the stakes of idols, and women will be full of hair-pins, O king, when the yuga ends.

verses.text:
अल्पक्षीरास्तथा गावो भविष्यन्ति जनाधिप ।
अल्पपुष्पफलाश्चापि पादपा बहुवायसाः ॥

meaning.en: Cows will give little milk, lord of men, and trees will have little flower and fruit and many crows.

verses.text:
ब्रह्मवध्यावलिप्तानां तथा मिथ्याभिशंसिनाम् ।
नृपाणां पृथिवीपाल प्रतिगृह्णन्ति वै द्विजाः ॥

meaning.en: Brahmins will accept gifts from kings stained with brahmin-slaying and from false accusers, protector of the earth.

verses.text:
लोभमोहपरीताश्च मिथ्याधर्मध्वजावृताः ।
भिक्षार्थं पृथिवीपाल चञ्चूर्यन्ते द्विजैर्दिशः ॥

meaning.en: Overcome by greed and delusion, covered with banners of false dharma, brahmins will roam the quarters for alms, protector of the earth.

verses.text:
करभारभयात्पुंसो गृहस्थाः परिमोषकाः ।
मुनिच्छद्माकृतिच्छन्ना वाणिज्यमुपजीवते ॥

meaning.en: For fear of taxes, householders will become robbers, and, disguised in the garb of sages, will live by trade.

verses.text:
मिथ्या च नखरोमाणि धारयन्ति नरास्तदा ।
अर्थलोभान्नरव्याघ्र वृथा च ब्रह्मचारिणः ॥

meaning.en: People will wear false nails and hair out of greed for wealth, tiger among men, and will be students of Brahman in vain.

verses.text:
आश्रमेषु वृथाचाराः पानपा गुरुतल्पगाः ।
ऐहलौकिकमीहन्ते मांसशोणितवर्धनम् ॥

meaning.en: In the stages of life people will behave pointlessly, will be drinkers and violators of their teacher's bed, and will seek only this-worldly gains, which fatten flesh and blood.

verses.text:
बहुपाषण्डसंकीर्णाः परान्नगुणवादिनः ।
आश्रमा मनुजव्याघ्र न भवन्ति युगक्षये ॥

meaning.en: Stages of life will be full of many heretics, and men will praise the virtues of others' food; so, tiger among men, the orders of life will cease at the end of the age.

verses.text:
यथर्तुवर्षी भगवान्न तथा पाकशासनः ।
न तदा सर्वबीजानि सम्यग्रोहन्ति भारत ।
अधर्मफलमत्यर्थं तदा भवति चानघ ॥

meaning.en: The blessed Indra will not rain in season as before, and then, Bharata, all seeds will not sprout properly. Then, sinless one, unrighteousness will bear very great fruit.

verses.text:
तथा च पृथिवीपाल यो भवेद्धर्मसंयुतः ।
अल्पायुः स हि मन्तव्यो न हि धर्मोऽस्ति कश्चन ॥

meaning.en: And so, protector of the earth, one who is devoted to dharma must be regarded as short-lived, for there is no dharma at all.

verses.text:
भूयिष्ठं कूटमानैश्च पण्यं विक्रीणते जनाः ।
वणिजश्च नरव्याघ्र बहुमाया भवन्त्युत ॥

meaning.en: People will mostly sell goods with false measures, and merchants, tiger among men, will be full of deceit.

verses.text:
धर्मिष्ठाः परिहीयन्ते पापीयान्वर्धते जनः ।
धर्मस्य बलहानिः स्यादधर्मश्च बली तथा ॥

meaning.en: The righteous will decline and the sinful man will thrive; dharma will lose strength and adharma will be strong.

verses.text:
अल्पायुषो दरिद्राश्च धर्मिष्ठा मानवास्तदा ।
दीर्घायुषः समृद्धाश्च विधर्माणो युगक्षये ॥

meaning.en: Righteous men will be short-lived and poor at that time, and those who are lawless will be long-lived and prosperous at the yuga's end.

verses.text:
अधर्मिष्ठैरुपायैश्च प्रजा व्यवहरन्त्युत ।
संचयेनापि चाल्पेन भवन्त्याढ्या मदान्विताः ॥

meaning.en: People will deal with one another by unrighteous means, and by even a small hoard will become rich and drunk with pride.

verses.text:
धनं विश्वासतो न्यस्तं मिथो भूयिष्ठशो नराः ।
हर्तुं व्यवसिता राजन्मायाचारसमन्विताः ॥

meaning.en: Men will mostly, king, resolve to steal wealth entrusted in trust, given to deceit and crooked conduct.

verses.text:
पुरुषादानि सत्त्वानि पक्षिणोऽथ मृगास्तथा ।
नगराणां विहारेषु चैत्येष्वपि च शेरते ॥

meaning.en: Man-eating creatures, birds and beasts will sleep in the pleasure parks of cities and in shrines.

verses.text:
सप्तवर्षाष्टवर्षाश्च स्त्रियो गर्भधरा नृप ।
दशद्वादशवर्षाणां पुंसां पुत्रः प्रजायते ॥

meaning.en: Women of seven or eight years will bear children, king, and men of ten or twelve years will beget sons.

verses.text:
भवन्ति षोडशे वर्षे नराः पलितिनस्तथा ।
आयुःक्षयो मनुष्याणां क्षिप्रमेव प्रपद्यते ॥

meaning.en: Men will turn gray at sixteen, and the loss of life of men will come very quickly.

verses.text:
क्षीणे युगे महाराज तरुणा वृद्धशीलिनः ।
तरुणानां च यच्छीलं तद्वृद्धेषु प्रजायते ॥

meaning.en: When the age has declined, great king, the young will behave like the old, and the conduct of the young will be found in the old.

verses.text:
विपरीतास्तदा नार्यो वञ्चयित्वा रहः पतीन् ।
व्युच्चरन्त्यपि दुःशीला दासैः पशुभिरेव च ॥

meaning.en: Then women will be perverse, cheating their husbands in secret; ill-behaved, they will have affairs with servants and even with animals.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्युगसहस्रान्ते संप्राप्ते चायुषः क्षये ।
अनावृष्टिर्महाराज जायते बहुवार्षिकी ॥

meaning.en: When that thousand yugas' end has come and life is spent, O great king, a long drought of many years arises.

verses.text:
ततस्तान्यल्पसाराणि सत्त्वानि क्षुधितानि च ।
प्रलयं यान्ति भूयिष्ठं पृथिव्यां पृथिवीपते ॥

meaning.en: Then those beings of little substance, hungry, will mostly perish on the earth, protector of the earth.

verses.text:
ततो दिनकरैर्दीप्तैः सप्तभिर्मनुजाधिप ।
पीयते सलिलं सर्वं समुद्रेषु सरित्सु च ॥

meaning.en: Then the seven blazing suns, lord of men, drink up all the water in the oceans and rivers.

verses.text:
यच्च काष्ठं तृणं चापि शुष्कं चार्द्रं च भारत ।
सर्वं तद्भस्मसाद्भूतं दृश्यते भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: And all wood and grass, dry and wet, O Bharata, is seen turned to ashes, best of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
ततः संवर्तको वह्निर्वायुना सह भारत ।
लोकमाविशते पूर्वमादित्यैरुपशोषितम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the fire Samvartaka, with the wind, O Bharata, enters the world, which the suns have already dried up.

verses.text:
ततः स पृथिवीं भित्त्वा समाविश्य रसातलम् ।
देवदानवयक्षाणां भयं जनयते महत् ॥

meaning.en: Then it breaks the earth, enters Rasatala, and brings great fear to gods, danavas and yakshas.

verses.text:
निर्दहन्नागलोकं च यच्च किंचित्क्षिताविह ।
अधस्तात्पृथिवीपाल सर्वं नाशयते क्षणात् ॥

meaning.en: Burning the world of the nagas and whatever there is on the ground here, it destroys everything below in a moment, protector of the earth.

verses.text:
ततो योजनविंशानां सहस्राणि शतानि च ।
निर्दहत्यशिवो वायुः स च संवर्तकोऽनलः ॥

meaning.en: Then that dreadful wind and the Samvartaka fire burn thousands and hundreds of twenty yojanas.

verses.text:
सदेवासुरगन्धर्वं सयक्षोरगराक्षसम् ।
ततो दहति दीप्तः स सर्वमेव जगद्विभुः ॥

meaning.en: Then that blazing lord burns up the whole universe with its gods, asuras, gandharvas, yakshas, serpents and rakshasas.

verses.text:
ततो गजकुलप्रख्यास्तडिन्मालाविभूषिताः ।
उत्तिष्ठन्ति महामेघा नभस्यद्भुतदर्शनाः ॥

meaning.en: Then great clouds like herds of elephants rise in the sky, adorned with garlands of lightning, wonderful to see.

verses.text:
केचिन्नीलोत्पलश्यामाः केचित्कुमुदसंनिभाः ।
केचित्किञ्जल्कसंकाशाः केचित्पीताः पयोधराः ॥

meaning.en: Some are dark like blue lotuses, some like white water lilies, some like lotus filaments, some yellow rain-bearers,

verses.text:
केचिद्धारिद्रसंकाशाः काकाण्डकनिभास्तथा ।
केचित्कमलपत्राभाः केचिद्धिङ्गुलकप्रभाः ॥

meaning.en: some like turmeric and some like crow's eggs, some like lotus petals, some with the glow of vermilion,

verses.text:
केचित्पुरवराकाराः केचिद्गजकुलोपमाः ।
केचिदञ्जनसंकाशाः केचिन्मकरसंस्थिताः ।
विद्युन्मालापिनद्धाङ्गाः समुत्तिष्ठन्ति वै घनाः ॥

meaning.en: some in the shape of fine cities, some like herds of elephants, some like collyrium, some like makaras, bodies bound with garlands of lightning: such clouds rise.

verses.text:
घोररूपा महाराज घोरस्वननिनादिताः ।
ततो जलधराः सर्वे व्याप्नुवन्ति नभस्तलम् ॥

meaning.en: Terrible in form, great king, and resounding with dreadful thunder, all those water-bearers fill the sky.

verses.text:
तैरियं पृथिवी सर्वा सपर्वतवनाकरा ।
आपूर्यते महाराज सलिलौघपरिप्लुता ॥

meaning.en: By them the whole earth, with its mountains, forests and mines, is filled and flooded with masses of water, great king.

verses.text:
ततस्ते जलदा घोरा राविणः पुरुषर्षभ ।
सर्वतः प्लावयन्त्याशु चोदिताः परमेष्ठिना ॥

meaning.en: Then those terrible roaring clouds, driven by Parameshthin, quickly flood everything on every side, best of men.

verses.text:
वर्षमाणा महत्तोयं पूरयन्तो वसुंधराम् ।
सुघोरमशिवं रौद्रं नाशयन्ति च पावकम् ॥

meaning.en: Pouring great waters and filling the earth, they put out that very terrible, inauspicious, fierce fire.

verses.text:
ततो द्वादश वर्षाणि पयोदास्त उपप्लवे ।
धाराभिः पूरयन्तो वै चोद्यमाना महात्मना ॥

meaning.en: Then for twelve years, in that deluge, those cloud-bearers fill everything with streams, driven by the great-souled one.

verses.text:
ततः समुद्रः स्वां वेलामतिक्रामति भारत ।
पर्वताश्च विशीर्यन्ते मही चापि विशीर्यते ॥

meaning.en: Then the ocean crosses its shore, Bharata, mountains are broken and the earth too is broken.

verses.text:
सर्वतः सहसा भ्रान्तास्ते पयोदा नभस्तलम् ।
संवेष्टयित्वा नश्यन्ति वायुवेगपराहताः ॥

meaning.en: Suddenly whirling everywhere, those clouds wrap the sky and perish, struck by the force of the wind.

verses.text:
ततस्तं मारुतं घोरं स्वयम्भूर्मनुजाधिप ।
आदिपद्मालयो देवः पीत्वा स्वपिति भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then the Self-existent god, whose first dwelling is the lotus, drinks up that terrible wind and sleeps, lord of men.

verses.text:
तस्मिन्नेकार्णवे घोरे नष्टे स्थावरजङ्गमे ।
नष्टे देवासुरगणे यक्षराक्षसवर्जिते ॥

meaning.en: In that terrible one ocean, with moving and unmoving things destroyed, with the hosts of gods and asuras gone and yakshas and rakshasas absent,

verses.text:
निर्मनुष्ये महीपाल निःश्वापदमहीरुहे ।
अनन्तरिक्षे लोकेऽस्मिन्भ्रमाम्येकोऽहमादृतः ॥

meaning.en: with no men, no beasts and no trees, in this world without sky, I alone wander, honored, lord of the earth.

verses.text:
एकार्णवे जले घोरे विचरन्पार्थिवोत्तम ।
अपश्यन्सर्वभूतानि वैक्लव्यमगमं परम् ॥

meaning.en: Wandering in that terrible waste of waters, best of kings, seeing no beings, I fell into great distress.

verses.text:
ततः सुदीर्घं गत्वा तु प्लवमानो नराधिप ।
श्रान्तः क्वचिन्न शरणं लभाम्यहमतन्द्रितः ॥

meaning.en: Then going a very long way, floating, tired, nowhere do I find shelter, king, though I am untiring.

verses.text:
ततः कदाचित्पश्यामि तस्मिन्सलिलसंप्लवे ।
न्यग्रोधं सुमहान्तं वै विशालं पृथिवीपते ॥

meaning.en: Then once, in that flood of water, I see a huge, wide banyan tree, protector of the earth.

verses.text:
शाखायां तस्य वृक्षस्य विस्तीर्णायां नराधिप ।
पर्यङ्के पृथिवीपाल दिव्यास्तरणसंस्तृते ॥

meaning.en: On a spreading branch of that tree, lord of men, on a couch spread with divine coverings,

verses.text:
उपविष्टं महाराज पूर्णेन्दुसदृशाननम् ।
फुल्लपद्मविशालाक्षं बालं पश्यामि भारत ॥

meaning.en: I see seated a boy with a face like the full moon and large eyes like opened lotuses, great king.

verses.text:
ततो मे पृथिवीपाल विस्मयः सुमहानभूत् ।
कथं त्वयं शिशुः शेते लोके नाशमुपागते ॥

meaning.en: Then great amazement came upon me, protector of the earth: how does this child lie here when the world has been destroyed?

verses.text:
तपसा चिन्तयंश्चापि तं शिशुं नोपलक्षये ।
भूतं भव्यं भविष्यच्च जानन्नपि नराधिप ॥

meaning.en: Though I thought by my austerity, I could not recognize that child, though I know the past, present and future, lord of men.

verses.text:
अतसीपुष्पवर्णाभः श्रीवत्सकृतलक्षणः ।
साक्षाल्लक्ष्म्या इवावासः स तदा प्रतिभाति मे ॥

meaning.en: He was the color of the flax flower and bore the Shrivatsa mark; he seemed to me then like the very dwelling of Lakshmi.

verses.text:
ततो मामब्रवीद्बालः स पद्मनिभलोचनः ।
श्रीवत्सधारी द्युतिमान्वाक्यं श्रुतिसुखावहम् ॥

meaning.en: Then that boy with lotus-like eyes, wearing the Shrivatsa and radiant, spoke to me words pleasing to the ear.

verses.text:
जानामि त्वा परिश्रान्तं तात विश्रामकाङ्क्षिणम् ।
मार्कण्डेय इहास्स्व त्वं यावदिच्छसि भार्गव ॥

meaning.en: 'I know you are very tired, dear one, and want rest. Markandeya, descendant of Bhrigu, stay here as long as you wish.

verses.text:
अभ्यन्तरं शरीरं मे प्रविश्य मुनिसत्तम ।
आस्स्व भो विहितो वासः प्रसादस्ते कृतो मया ॥

meaning.en: Enter my body, best of sages, and stay, sir. A dwelling is provided; I have shown you this favor.'

verses.text:
ततो बालेन तेनैवमुक्तस्यासीत्तदा मम ।
निर्वेदो जीविते दीर्घे मनुष्यत्वे च भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then, addressed by that boy so, I felt disgust for my long life and for being human, Bharata.

verses.text:
ततो बालेन तेनास्यं सहसा विवृतं कृतम् ।
तस्याहमवशो वक्त्रं दैवयोगात्प्रवेशितः ॥

meaning.en: Then that boy suddenly opened his mouth, and I, helpless, was made to enter his mouth by the working of fate.

verses.text:
ततः प्रविष्टस्तत्कुक्षिं सहसा मनुजाधिप ।
सराष्ट्रनगराकीर्णां कृत्स्नां पश्यामि मेदिनीम् ॥

meaning.en: Having entered his belly, lord of men, I suddenly saw the whole earth, with its realms and cities.

verses.text:
गङ्गां शतद्रुं सीतां च यमुनामथ कौशिकीम् ।
चर्मण्वतीं वेत्रवतीं चन्द्रभागां सरस्वतीम् ॥

meaning.en: I saw the Ganga, Shatadru, Sita, the Yamuna, the Kaushiki, Charmanvati, Vetravati, Chandrabhaga and Sarasvati,

verses.text:
सिन्धुं चैव विपाशां च नदीं गोदावरीमपि ।
वस्वोकसारां नलिनीं नर्मदां चैव भारत ॥

meaning.en: the Sindhu, the Vipasha, the river Godavari, Vasvokasara, Nalini and Narmada, Bharata,

verses.text:
नदीं ताम्रां च वेण्णां च पुण्यतोयां शुभावहाम् ।
सुवेणां कृष्णवेणां च इरामां च महानदीम् ।
शोणं च पुरुषव्याघ्र विशल्यां कम्पुनामपि ॥

meaning.en: the river Tamra and the Venna, whose waters are holy and bring good, Suvena, Krishnavena, and the great river Irama, and the Shona, tiger among men, Vishalya and Kampuna.

verses.text:
एताश्चान्याश्च नद्योऽहं पृथिव्यां या नरोत्तम ।
परिक्रामन्प्रपश्यामि तस्य कुक्षौ महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: These and other rivers that there are on earth, best of men, I saw as I wandered in the belly of that great-souled one.

verses.text:
ततः समुद्रं पश्यामि यादोगणनिषेवितम् ।
रत्नाकरममित्रघ्न निधानं पयसो महत् ॥

meaning.en: Then I saw the ocean, home of hosts of sea creatures, a mine of jewels, slayer of foes, a great store of water.

verses.text:
ततः पश्यामि गगनं चन्द्रसूर्यविराजितम् ।
जाज्वल्यमानं तेजोभिः पावकार्कसमप्रभैः ।
पश्यामि च महीं राजन्काननैरुपशोभिताम् ॥

meaning.en: Then I saw the sky shining with moon and sun, blazing with lights like fire and sun, and I saw the earth adorned with forests, king.

verses.text:
यजन्ते हि तदा राजन्ब्राह्मणा बहुभिः सवैः ।
क्षत्रियाश्च प्रवर्तन्ते सर्ववर्णानुरञ्जने ॥

meaning.en: Then, O king, brahmins were sacrificing with many rites, and kshatriyas were engaged in pleasing all the classes.

verses.text:
वैश्याः कृषिं यथान्यायं कारयन्ति नराधिप ।
शुश्रूषायां च निरता द्विजानां वृषलास्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Vaishyas had agriculture done as is proper, lord of men, and shudras were devoted to serving the twice-born.

verses.text:
ततः परिपतन्राजंस्तस्य कुक्षौ महात्मनः ।
हिमवन्तं च पश्यामि हेमकूटं च पर्वतम् ॥

meaning.en: Then, as I moved about in the belly of that great-souled one, I saw the Himalaya and the mountain Hemakuta.

verses.text:
निषधं चापि पश्यामि श्वेतं च रजताचितम् ।
पश्यामि च महीपाल पर्वतं गन्धमादनम् ॥

meaning.en: I saw also Nishadha, and Shveta, studded with silver, and I saw, protector of the earth, the mountain Gandhamadana,

verses.text:
मन्दरं मनुजव्याघ्र नीलं चापि महागिरिम् ।
पश्यामि च महाराज मेरुं कनकपर्वतम् ॥

meaning.en: Mandara, tiger among men, and the great mountain Nila, and, great king, Meru, the golden mountain.

verses.text:
महेन्द्रं चैव पश्यामि विन्ध्यं च गिरिमुत्तमम् ।
मलयं चापि पश्यामि पारियात्रं च पर्वतम् ॥

meaning.en: I saw Mahendra and Vindhya, the best of mountains, and I saw Malaya and the Pariyatra mountain.

verses.text:
एते चान्ये च बहवो यावन्तः पृथिवीधराः ।
तस्योदरे मया दृष्टाः सर्वरत्नविभूषिताः ॥

meaning.en: These and many other mountains, as many as there are, adorned with all jewels, I saw in his belly.

verses.text:
सिंहान्व्याघ्रान्वराहांश्च नागांश्च मनुजाधिप ।
पृथिव्यां यानि चान्यानि सत्त्वानि जगतीपते ।
तानि सर्वाण्यहं तत्र पश्यन्पर्यचरं तदा ॥

meaning.en: Lions, tigers, boars and elephants, lord of men, and the other creatures that are on earth, protector of the world, I saw all those as I roamed there.

verses.text:
कुक्षौ तस्य नरव्याघ्र प्रविष्टः संचरन्दिशः ।
शक्रादींश्चापि पश्यामि कृत्स्नान्देवगणांस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Having entered his belly and moving through the directions, tiger among men, I saw Indra and the others, all the hosts of gods,

verses.text:
गन्धर्वाप्सरसो यक्षानृषींश्चैव महीपते ।
दैत्यदानवसंघांश्च कालेयांश्च नराधिप ।
सिंहिकातनयांश्चापि ये चान्ये सुरशत्रवः ॥

meaning.en: gandharvas, apsaras, yakshas and sages, protector of the earth, and hosts of daityas and danavas, Kaleyas and the sons of Simhika and the other enemies of the gods.

verses.text:
यच्च किंचिन्मया लोके दृष्टं स्थावरजङ्गमम् ।
तदपश्यमहं सर्वं तस्य कुक्षौ महात्मनः ।
फलाहारः प्रविचरन्कृत्स्नं जगदिदं तदा ॥

meaning.en: Whatever I had ever seen in the world, moving or unmoving, all that I saw in that great-souled one's belly, roaming about this whole world, living on fruit.

verses.text:
अन्तः शरीरे तस्याहं वर्षाणामधिकं शतम् ।
न च पश्यामि तस्याहमन्तं देहस्य कुत्रचित् ॥

meaning.en: For more than a hundred years I stayed inside his body, and nowhere did I see the end of his body.

verses.text:
सततं धावमानश्च चिन्तयानो विशां पते ।
आसादयामि नैवान्तं तस्य राजन्महात्मनः ॥

meaning.en: Running constantly and thinking, lord of men, I did not reach the end of that great-souled one, king.

verses.text:
ततस्तमेव शरणं गतोऽस्मि विधिवत्तदा ।
वरेण्यं वरदं देवं मनसा कर्मणैव च ॥

meaning.en: Then I took refuge in him alone, duly, as the god worthy of choice and granter of boons, in mind and deed.

verses.text:
ततोऽहं सहसा राजन्वायुवेगेन निःसृतः ।
महात्मनो मुखात्तस्य विवृतात्पुरुषोत्तम ॥

meaning.en: Then suddenly, O king, I was swept out by the force of wind from the opened mouth of that great-souled one, best of men.

verses.text:
ततस्तस्यैव शाखायां न्यग्रोधस्य विशां पते ।
आस्ते मनुजशार्दूल कृत्स्नमादाय वै जगत् ॥

meaning.en: Then I saw him seated on the very branch of the banyan tree, lord of men, tiger among men, holding the whole world within.

verses.text:
तेनैव बालवेषेण श्रीवत्सकृतलक्षणम् ।
आसीनं तं नरव्याघ्र पश्याम्यमिततेजसम् ॥

meaning.en: In that same boyish form, bearing the Shrivatsa mark, I saw that one of boundless splendor seated, tiger among men.

verses.text:
ततो मामब्रवीद्वीर स बालः प्रहसन्निव ।
श्रीवत्सधारी द्युतिमान्पीतवासा महाद्युतिः ॥

meaning.en: Then that boy, as if laughing, wearing the Shrivatsa, radiant, in yellow garments and of great brilliance, said to me, hero:

verses.text:
अपीदानीं शरीरेऽस्मिन्मामके मुनिसत्तम ।
उषितस्त्वं सुविश्रान्तो मार्कण्डेय ब्रवीहि मे ॥

meaning.en: 'Now, best of sages, have you stayed in this body of mine and rested well, Markandeya? Tell me.'

verses.text:
मुहूर्तादथ मे दृष्टिः प्रादुर्भूता पुनर्नवा ।
यया निर्मुक्तमात्मानमपश्यं लब्धचेतसम् ॥

meaning.en: After a moment a new sight arose in me, by which I saw myself freed and with my senses regained.

verses.text:
तस्य ताम्रतलौ तात चरणौ सुप्रतिष्ठितौ ।
सुजातौ मृदुरक्ताभिरङ्गुलीभिरलंकृतौ ॥

meaning.en: His feet, dear one, with coppery soles, well set and finely made, were adorned with soft red toes.

verses.text:
प्रयतेन मया मूर्ध्ना गृहीत्वा ह्यभिवन्दितौ ।
दृष्ट्वापरिमितं तस्य प्रभावममितौजसः ॥

meaning.en: Carefully, I took them on my head and saluted them, having seen the immeasurable power of that one of limitless energy.

verses.text:
विनयेनाञ्जलिं कृत्वा प्रयत्नेनोपगम्य च ।
दृष्टो मया स भूतात्मा देवः कमललोचनः ॥

meaning.en: With humility, joining my palms and approaching with effort, I saw that Soul of beings, the lotus-eyed god.

verses.text:
तमहं प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा नमस्कृत्येदमब्रुवम् ।
ज्ञातुमिच्छामि देव त्वां मायां चेमां तवोत्तमाम् ॥

meaning.en: Joining my hands, I bowed to him and said, 'I wish to know you, lord, and this supreme illusion of yours.

verses.text:
आस्येनानुप्रविष्टोऽहं शरीरं भगवंस्तव ।
दृष्टवानखिलाँल्लोकान्समस्ताञ्जठरे तव ॥

meaning.en: Blessed one, I entered your body by your mouth and saw all the worlds in your belly.

verses.text:
तव देव शरीरस्था देवदानवराक्षसाः ।
यक्षगन्धर्वनागाश्च जगत्स्थावरजङ्गमम् ॥

meaning.en: Gods, danavas and rakshasas, yakshas, gandharvas and nagas, and the world moving and unmoving, were in your body, god.

verses.text:
त्वत्प्रसादाच्च मे देव स्मृतिर्न परिहीयते ।
द्रुतमन्तः शरीरे ते सततं परिधावतः ॥

meaning.en: By your grace, god, my memory has not failed, though I ran constantly and swiftly inside your body.

verses.text:
इच्छामि पुण्डरीकाक्ष ज्ञातुं त्वाहमनिन्दित ।
इह भूत्वा शिशुः साक्षात्किं भवानवतिष्ठते ।
पीत्वा जगदिदं विश्वमेतदाख्यातुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: I wish to know you, lotus-eyed and blameless one: why do you remain here as a boy, having swallowed this whole universe? You should tell me this.

verses.text:
किमर्थं च जगत्सर्वं शरीरस्थं तवानघ ।
कियन्तं च त्वया कालमिह स्थेयमरिंदम ॥

meaning.en: And why is the whole world in your body, sinless one, and how long, tamer of foes, must you remain here?

verses.text:
एतदिच्छामि देवेश श्रोतुं ब्राह्मणकाम्यया ।
त्वत्तः कमलपत्राक्ष विस्तरेण यथातथम् ।
महद्ध्येतदचिन्त्यं च यदहं दृष्टवान्प्रभो ॥

meaning.en: Lord of gods, I wish to hear this from you in full detail and exactly, lotus-petaled eyes, for the sake of brahmins, for what I have seen is great and inconceivable, lord.'

verses.text:
इत्युक्तः स मया श्रीमान्देवदेवो महाद्युतिः ।
सान्त्वयन्मामिदं वाक्यमुवाच वदतां वरः ॥

meaning.en: So addressed by me, the glorious god of gods, of great radiance, the best of speakers, consoling me, spoke these words."
